sessionName: Week 4 - Founder meetings and term sheets
summary: George Berrington worked through Fernhill's deal process with Daniel Reese and Amira Khan. Founders say Fernhill is slower than larger funds to get to a term sheet. We agreed a tighter discovery approach and a term sheet target.

discussion.keyPoints: Average time from first meeting to term sheet is 9 weeks; Amira said a lost deal went to a fund that issued in 4 weeks.
Daniel admitted the team rarely asks founders what else they are considering.
Founders most often push back on board seat rights and liquidation preference.

recommendations.recommendation: Ask every founder in the first meeting about other funds in conversation and their timeline for a decision.
Only take a deal to investment committee pre-screen if the founder confirms a raise within 6 months.
Issue term sheets within 5 weeks of first meeting, from 9 weeks today.
Offer a 1x non-participating liquidation preference as standard to remove that objection.

actions.action: Redesign the investment committee pre-screen paper to 2 pages

nextFocus: Set up the deal pipeline stages and conversion tracking.
nextPreparation: Amira to export the deal tracker from the last 2 years.

tests.question: What is our target time to issue term sheets?
Did we agree a standard 1x liquidation preference?
When do we take a deal to the pre-screen?
